items.name: Back in Mauritius 2023
items.information: Welcome! This will be the fourth official competition held in Mauritius... I, the delegate, is coming as a tourist and wanted to give others the oportunity to take part in speedcubing... I hope to meet many enthusiastic competitiors and we'll have a great time... We will begin from 5pm onwards...

venue.name: Institut français De Maurice
venue.address: Institut français De Maurice, Julius Nyerere Ave, Beau Bassin-Rose Hill, Mauritius

items.information: ## Welcome to the 6th official WCA competition in Mauritius! ## This competition counts as **Mauritius Nationals** for 2026, so the winner of each event that is of Mauritian Nationality will be crowned **National Champion**!
